question: What is the main goal of the Ayushman Bharat scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**To provide affordable healthcare**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 
 
• **Ayushman Bharat**, also known as the **Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY)**, was launched by the Government of India to provide **accessible and affordable healthcare services** to economically weaker sections of society. 
 
• The scheme aims to **cover over 10 crore poor and vulnerable families**, offering a coverage of up to **Rs. 5 lakh per family per year** for secondary and tertiary hospitalization. 
 
• Ayushman Bharat focuses on two main components: **Health and Wellness Centres (HWCs)** and the **PMJAY health insurance scheme**. HWCs aim to provide **comprehensive primary healthcare services**, while PMJAY ensures **financial protection for hospitalization costs**. 
 
• The scheme is designed to reduce **out-of-pocket healthcare expenses**, ensuring that families below the poverty line receive **cashless treatment** at empanelled public and private hospitals.
